text: We recently worked with DKLevy for a major renovation and addition to a 60’s brick home. Daniel listened to our wishlist and provided suggestions on where to concentrate funds to make the most impact. His attention to details and cost made the experience very rewarding. We could not be happier with the outcome of our project and working with Daniel and his staff was a pleasure.
